“`

Boom…

After the amplification of his Spirit Will by tenfold, Lin Yuan immediately felt the oppressive force that had once rendered him immobile vanish in an instant.

It was as if he had been freed from shackles, becoming incredibly liberated.

“Seize the time,”

Lin Yuan immediately strode forward.

...

At this moment, the pressure enveloping from the second level of the Black Tower no longer posed any hindrance to Lin Yuan,

except for a brief pause when he was just five meters away. In the end, it only took him four breaths to pass through the second level of the Black Tower.

“Did he really get through?”

Outside the nine-leveled Black Tower, the Stone Statue Shen Ji fell silent once again.

Even though it had anticipated this possibility… after all, judging by Lin Yuan’s performance in mastering the Space Rules, it seemed that breaking through the second level of the Black Tower as an Eighth Layer being wasn’t entirely impossible.

But when the scene truly unfolded before it, Statue Shen Ji was still overwhelmed with shock.

“His breath surged massively at the end, did he use some kind of explosive secret technique?”

The Stone Statue Shen Ji pondered, aware of the rules laid down by the Moyu Tower Master, which prohibited the use of any ‘external forces’ during the challenge.

However, techniques that induced a burst of power drew entirely from one’s own strength and didn’t count as ‘external forces’.

Thus, Lin Yuan’s passing through the second level of the Black Tower was within the rules.

Whoosh.

Stone Statue Shen Ji’s figure vanished, reappearing in the central area of the second level of the Black Tower.

At this moment, Lin Yuan was also standing there, having taken only four breaths to complete the final stretch through the second level. The ‘Divine Skills’ enhancement duration still had six breaths left.

“Senior Shen Ji, may I go and challenge the third level?”

Lin Yuan did not intend to waste the remaining six breaths as he felt stronger than he had ever been.

“Hmm? Sure.”

Seeing Lin Yuan’s condition, Stone Statue Shen Ji nodded in agreement.

“Then I’m heading up,”

Lin Yuan immediately ascended the black staircase toward the third level.

Four breaths of enhanced duration remained.

…

Boom.

As soon as Lin Yuan entered the third level, he was met with an omnipresent terrifying pressure.

This pressure was so immense, it felt like a cosmos collapsing down upon him. Even with a tenfold increase in his strength, Lin Yuan could feel an absolute void around him and numerous varieties of Cosmic Forces rapidly disintegrating.

“How can I withstand this?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts raced.

Even during the enhanced period of his ‘Divine Skills,’ it was tough, and once the enhancement ended and he fell into a state of weakness, the outcome was predictable.

“Forget it.”

After gauging the difficulty of the third level, Lin Yuan decisively retreated.

He hadn’t planned to pass the third level in this attempt; he’d gone up only because he didn’t want to waste the ‘Divine Skills’ enhancement, wanting to see and try it out for himself.

“The third level of the Black Tower is specifically designed for the extremely powerful entities among Ninth Rank life forms, as well as for Tenth Rank life. It’s completely normal for you not to get through…”

Seeing Lin Yuan return, Stone Statue Shen Ji couldn’t help but speak.

The extremely powerful entities among Ninth Rank life forms were akin to undefeated beings in the Eighth Layer.

They possessed combat power that surpassed their own level.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan nodded. Not to mention getting through the third level, just staying there was enough to be overwhelmed by the pressure coming from all directions.

The gap was too great.

“Alright.”

“Since you’ve passed the second level, according to the rules set by the original master, you will receive a treasure from the second level’s reward repository.”

“The value of the treasure will depend on your performance on the second level.”

The Stone Statue looked at Lin Yuan and said.

“Treasure?”

A thrill filled Lin Yuan’s heart.

He had seen the many treasures in the reward repository of the Black Tower’s second level, many of which were rare and unheard of in the Main World.

“Regarding your performance on the second level… in terms of speed, you could only be considered ordinary among those who had passed through the second level in the past,”

Stone Statue Shen Ji stated.

“`

“Speed is indeed not fast.”

Lin Yuan nodded, with only the final fifty meters distance, activating the ‘Strengthening’ Divine Skill barely involved any halting, but he couldn’t be considered fast earlier, averaging out, fitting the stone statue’s assessment.

“But in terms of strength…”

The stone statue conveyed a complex tone.

Eighth Layer.

Lin Yuan was merely at the Eighth Layer.

Yet he had passed through the Second Layer, an event that not even in the heyday of Moyu Tower had ever occurred.

Certainly, there were Eighth Layer lives that had made it through the Second Layer, even halfway through, but in the end, they had all failed. No one like Lin Yuan had managed to break through.

“So, after a comprehensive evaluation, you can select any one treasure from the reward vault of the Second Layer or the Third Layer in the Dark Tower.”

The stone statue spoke with a grave tone.

Compared to when Lin Yuan had passed through the First Layer and could select three treasures from the First and Second Layer,

This time Lin Yuan could only choose one, but you should know that this time, his range of selection has expanded to the Third Layer.

Any single reward taken from the Third Layer’s vault is unknowably more valuable than those from the First or the Second; the stone statue Shen Ji opening the Third Layer’s reward vault to Lin Yuan was rather unconventional.

But the stone statue Shen Ji believed that even if the owner of Moyu Tower were to return, they would not object to his decision, as Lin Yuan’s talent was monstrously outstanding.

“Here is the reward list, take your time to choose.”

With a wave of his hand, the stone statue Shen Ji caused a series of treasure phantoms to appear before him.

…

Battlefield B0001 of Different Races.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Primordial Spirit finally arrived at this battlefield, near the largest of those Eternal Spatial Rifts.

“That rift…”

Lin Yuan looked toward the distant terrifying rift stretching across the sky, with a length exceeding thirty thousand meters, emanating an aura profound and ancient, making one’s heart tremble.

“Let’s see the enhancement in the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force…”

Lin Yuan immediately drew closer to feel it carefully. In the Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield where the Taiyin Primordial Spirit was located, the Eternal Spatial Rift was only ten thousand meters in length.

It could not compare to the current thirty thousand meter long Eternal Spatial Rift.

A moment later.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“The current speed of accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force is… one strand in 150 days?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The initial accumulation speed of World-Breaking Origin Force was one strand every 333 days.

Leveraging the Eternal Spatial Rift in a small battlefield, it dropped to one strand every 280 to 290 days.

After going to a Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield and relying on that ten thousand meter long Eternal Spatial Rift, he needed only 200 days to accumulate a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force.

Now it required only 150 days.

“Even if the war with the Tianyu Clan comes to a pause, I should still station a Primordial Spirit Avatar on this battlefield…”

Lin Yuan had made up his mind.

With his current strength, even the constantly highly intense Battlefield B0001 posed no threat to him.

…

Time slowly ticked by.

Two years had flashed by in an instant.

In the center of Battlefield B0001, both the Tianyu Clan and human civilization had arrayed their mighty armies across from each other.

The Baiyun Lord and other invincible Eighth Layer Evolvers from humanity stood under the sky, watching the Tianyu side with heavy gazes.

“Baiyun, the Tianyu Clan seems determined to win this time, launching a full-scale offensive so swiftly; they evidently have a strong confidence in victory,” said one Eighth Layer Evolver softly.

If the strength was merely equal, or if they did not hold a crushing advantage, the Tianyu Clan would not hasten to a decisive battle so quickly. They would certainly accumulate as much strength as possible to improve their odds of victory.

Since the opposition was so eager, it clearly had considerable confidence, thinking it could conquer the arrangements of human civilization on this battlefield.

As peak clans, even if the Tianyu Clan were slightly weaker than human civilization, the gap was small, and they frequently held the advantage on the battlefield.

“Damn it, if it weren’t for our human civilization being restrained by the Insect Race Alliance and the Star Alliance, which prevents us from drawing more powerhouses, how could these bird people from the Tianyu Clan seize the opportunity,” another Eighth Layer Evolver said angrily.

The battlefields expanded by human civilization generally held the upper hand, but there were occasional disadvantages.

This time, for instance, human civilization decided to support several other battlefields, which inevitably led to insufficient reinforcement for the remaining ones.

“It doesn’t matter,” said the Baiyun Lord nonchalantly, “The Galaxy Master has already arrived at the battlefield. He might be watching us right now. You just fight freely when it’s time.”
